name: Seneca Lake

climate.koppen_name: Cold, no dry season, hot summer

terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

blurb.text: A Finger Lakes AVA around Seneca Lake. The deep lake has not frozen over since the early 20th century, so it stores heat and lengthens the growing season. Riesling is the region's leading vinifera grape.
